data.title: 夜刀神十香 · 海边的黄豆粉冰饮
data.description: 【海滨度假木栈桥·正午】十香穿着紫色系泳装，双手抱住比脸还大的黄豆粉冰饮，坐在栈桥边让脚尖拍打海水；一阵海风吹来，她的蝴蝶结和长发同时飞起，兴奋地朝远处的浪花挥手。
data.location: sunlit wooden pier at a quiet resort beach
data.action: 栈桥边抱巨大冰饮拍水，海风吹起长发与蝴蝶结，朝浪花兴奋挥手
data.lighting: bright noon light and blue water reflections
data.mood: 发现人类假日的新鲜快乐
data.promptProse: Tohka Yatogami from Date A Live wears a violet ruffled swimsuit with a large ribbon, a light cover-up skirt and barefoot sandals. She sits on the end of the wooden pier with an oversized soybean-flavored ice drink balanced in both hands. Her feet stir the shallow water while the wind lifts her long dark-purple hair and ribbon, and she beams at the next wave as if it were another wonderful discovery. bright noon light and blue water reflections.
